title: Close the SmokeCraft <-> POS360 identity gap
root_cause: SmokeCraft uses text venue/tenant/guest ids; POS360's customer/loyalty tables (pos360_customers, pos360_loyalty_profiles, pos360_loyalty_points_ledger) use uuid venue_id/tenant_id/customer_id with no external FK to a canonical venues/tenants registry (confirmed via pg_constraint audit) — POS360's uuid namespace is opaque and self-consistent within its own module tables only.
audit_findings: pos360_guest_smokecraft_links (migration 038) already existed as a real table with a FK to pos360_customers, but was an unused placeholder — only a read (getSmokecraftLink) existed, no write path, and no unique constraint (so a naive caller could still race a duplicate). Reused this table for the customer link instead of creating a parallel one.

No existing table mapped SmokeCraft text venue/tenant ids to POS360 uuids anywhere in the schema. external_pos_tenant_mapping, pos_location_mappings, and the various *_tenant_mapping tables are for other integrations (payment providers, inventory, generic POS mapping) and do not cover this pairing.

No canonical POS360 'venues'/'tenants' uuid registry exists at all — pos360_customers.venue_id/tenant_id have no FK, so there is no external authority to violate; minting one stable uuid per SmokeCraft venue/tenant via a governed mapping table is the correct fix, not a workaround.

new_architecture.new_table: pos360_smokecraft_identity_map (entity_type venue|tenant, smokecraft_external_id, pos360_uuid) — unique on (entity_type, smokecraft_external_id) for idempotent forward lookup, unique on pos360_uuid for reverse lookup
new_architecture.reused_table: pos360_guest_smokecraft_links — added unique index (venue_id, smokecraft_user_id) to make the pre-existing table genuinely idempotent
new_architecture.new_service: server/services/pos360/pos360SmokeCraftIdentityMappingService.js — resolveVenueMapping, resolveTenantMapping, resolveCustomerMapping, resolveFullIdentity, reverseLookup. Every function is select-first, insert-with-ON-CONFLICT-DO-NOTHING, re-select-on-race. No other code path is allowed to mint a POS360 uuid.
new_architecture.rewired: pos360SmokeCraftOrderBridgeService.js's accrueLoyaltyForFulfilledOrder() now resolves identity exclusively through this service instead of the Block 4A ad-hoc metadata lookup.

evidence: 2 concurrent identical venue-mapping requests (real race, launched in parallel) resulted in exactly 1 row in pos360_smokecraft_identity_map for that venue — proven via psql count after `wait`.
Same real SmokeCraft guest making 2 separate real purchases at the same venue resolved to the identical pos360CustomerId, pos360VenueUuid, and pos360TenantUuid both times — no re-minting.
Reverse lookup implemented (reverseLookup by pos360Uuid -> entityType + smokecraft_external_id).

Real SmokeCraft venue id 'hf5c2a-test-venue-1785369416088' resolved once to POS360 venue uuid 460d8f6b-9a8a-4840-8ec6-3c6907c419f8; every subsequent real purchase from that venue reused the same uuid (verified via psql on pos360_smokecraft_identity_map and on pos360_loyalty_profiles.venue_id).
No fake/random uuid generated per-request — the uuid is minted exactly once (first resolve) and persisted.

Real SmokeCraft guest 'smokecraft-player-4b-001' resolved once to POS360 customer uuid 44de5356-5e50-4af8-aa11-0746a73602f9 across 2 separate real order-fulfillment events; both accrued to the same loyalty profile (balance 10 -> 20), proving one customer record, not two.

Concurrent-race customer test: 2 parallel purchases for the same new guest produced exactly 1 row in pos360_guest_smokecraft_links and exactly 1 row in pos360_customers for that guest, with correct cumulative balance (10 -> 20) — no duplicate customer under a race.

Full real chain executed: POST /api/pos360/smokecraft/order-intent (Request/Purchase bridge, real venue/guest/session ids) -> staff-action actionType=order_fulfilled -> identity resolved through the new mapping layer -> pos360_loyalty_points_ledger row written -> pos360_loyalty_profiles.points_balance updated -> API response newBalance matches DB points_balance exactly (10, then 20 after a second real purchase) -> psql read-back confirms server balance == ledger balance_after == API-reported balance.
XP/points separation preserved: this path never touches session.xp or any SmokeCraft XP table; loyalty lives entirely in pos360_loyalty_* tables.
Retried order_fulfilled staff action on the same order intent returns duplicate:true, pointsEarned:0, balance unchanged (10, not 20) — proven via 2x curl + psql.
Concurrent identical venue-mapping requests: exactly 1 identity-map row (race-safe ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING + re-select).
Concurrent identical guest purchases: exactly 1 customer record, exactly 1 loyalty profile, correctly accumulated (not duplicated) balance.

pos360_regression.evidence: Re-ran order-intent idempotency: identical idempotencyKey twice -> duplicate:false then duplicate:true, same order_intent_id both times.

eat_regression.evidence: Re-ran session-sync idempotency: identical idempotencyKey twice -> duplicate:false then duplicate:true, same sync_id both times.

management_sync_regression.evidence: Re-ran journey create -> snapshot -> complete -> complete again (alreadyCompleted:true, no state change).

ticket_tapper_regression.evidence: Re-ran create -> publish -> tap -> report; all real DB-backed, all ok:true.

failure_safety_tests: Invalid/unknown SmokeCraft venue id ('invalid-venue-xyz') still resolves deterministically (any non-empty text id is a valid SmokeCraft external id by design — this bridge does not attempt to validate against a SmokeCraft-side venue registry it doesn't own); the mapping layer itself does not fabricate anything beyond persisting the mapping.

Missing venueId/tenantId entirely on a fulfillment action: loyalty step fails explicitly with ok:false, error:'missing_smokecraft_venue_or_tenant' — no identity fabricated, no ledger write, staff action itself still recorded (order status still updates) so the failure is isolated and explicit rather than blocking the whole request.
Duplicate commerce event (retried order_fulfilled): explicit duplicate:true, zero points, no new ledger row.
Concurrent/racing identical mapping and purchase requests: proven safe via ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING + re-select fallback at every write.
defects_fixed_this_block: Block 4A's loyalty accrual used an ad-hoc, unauthoritative customer lookup (metadata->>'smokecraft_guest_id') and passed SmokeCraft's raw text venue/tenant ids directly into uuid columns, which failed with 'invalid input syntax for type uuid' for every real SmokeCraft venue. Replaced with a governed, persisted, idempotent identity-mapping service that resolves real POS360 uuids once and reuses them forever.

pos360_guest_smokecraft_links existed but was unused and had no unique constraint — added the missing unique index and the missing write path (find-or-create), making a previously-dead table load-bearing.
exact_unresolved_blockers: None for the accepted scope. The mapping layer is a real, additive registry (not a workaround) given POS360 itself has no canonical venue/tenant uuid authority to conform to — this is the correct permanent architecture, not a temporary patch.
